source.stem: Fig. 4.1 is a ray diagram representing two rays passing through a converging lens.

parts.text: State which of the labelled points is a principal focus of the lens. [1]

intelligence.enrichment: The shape, size, and sharpness of a shadow depend on the position of the object relative to the light source and the screen. Changing the relative positions of the light source, object, and screen changes the geometry of the light that is blocked and therefore changes the observed shadow. The learner correctly applies this rule: The shape, size, and sharpness of a shadow depend on the position of the object relative to the light source and the screen. A shadow always has the same shape, size, and sharp edge as the object.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Light. The student must decide: Predict changes in a shadow's shape, size, and sharpness from the positions of the object, light source, and screen. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Supply exactly one complete tikzpicture. The stem must refer to that figure. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
